t.2634-33-5.agn: Its harmonised classification was updated in 2024 (ATP21); it is a skin sensitiser (Skin Sens. 1A). At the low concentrations used in products, the pure substance's acute toxicity class does not carry over to the label. It must be listed by name on the detergent label as a preservative.
t.2634-33-5.pw.0: A preservative that can cause contact allergy; if you are allergic to isothiazolinones, look for it on the label.
t.2634-33-5.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 613-088-00-6 (ATP21): Acute Tox. 2 (Inhalation), Acute Tox. 4 (Oral), Skin Irrit. 2, Eye Dam. 1, Skin Sens. 1A, Aquatic Acute 1, Aquatic Chronic 1.
t.2634-33-5.reg.det: Must be listed by name (INCI) on the detergent label as a preservative, whatever its concentration.
t.2634-33-5.reg.ulke.TR: Türkiye SEA Regulation Annex 6 (Official Gazette 10.12.2020), index no 613-088-00-6: Acute Tox. 4 (Oral), Skin Irrit. 2, Eye Dam. 1, Skin Sens. 1, Aquatic Acute 1. Difference from the EU: in the EU but not here: Acute Tox. 2 (Inhalation), Skin Sens. 1A, Aquatic Chronic 1; here but not in the EU: Skin Sens. 1.
t.2634-33-5.summary: A preservative (biocide) from the isothiazolinone group.
t.2634-33-5.what: Stops bacteria and fungi from growing in water-based products.
